caption: The drawing depicts a single glass pitcher, which has a wide, rounded body, a narrow neck, a flared spout, and a curved handle extending from the body to near the rim. The pitcher is predominantly colored in shades of golden brown and amber, suggesting a transparent glass material. It features a pattern of white or light blue curved lines looping in an overlapping fashion around the entire surface, creating a decorative design. The handle and the base of the pitcher are rendered in a darker shade of brown. The background is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or designs. The composition centers the pitcher in the frame, with the pitcher shown in profile, handle to the left and spout to the right.
title: Glass Pitcher
